parameters.threshold_note: Exploratory radar threshold. candidate if delta_db <= -threshold_db. Not a forest-loss threshold.
parameters.mask_rule: valid if mask in 1..254 (subswath number of a fully focused averaging ensemble); 0 = invalid; 255 = fill. Source: NISAR GCOV product specification as summarized by ASF docs and file attributes; see processing-log for the attributes read from the file.

stages.rule: highest-priority collection tier with a compatible pair; coverage within 90% of the tier maximum; most recent final date; then shortest interval (fewest temporal confounders)
